title: Obsidian Graph Stats Feed Freshness Gap
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:stats
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by source_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>48
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects vault scans or export jobs that have stopped updating obsidian graph stats on time.
value: Freshness monitoring matters because stale exports make a note system look healthier or busier than it really is.
implementation: Write a stable `source_name` for each exporter or workspace connector.
visualization: Table of exporters by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It maps when the data feed for obsidian graph stats has gone stale.
